P4 Model Remove Feature Engineering QB
```{r}
set.seed(42)

# --- 0. Load Libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(pROC)
library(car)

colnames(qb_full_fbs)

# ============================================================
# 0.5 Convert Percentage Columns → Decimals (0–1 scale)
# ============================================================

pct_cols <- colnames(qb_full_fbs)[
  grepl("Percentage", colnames(qb_full_fbs)) |
  grepl("\\.Percentage$", colnames(qb_full_fbs)) |
  grepl("Per\\.Percentage", colnames(qb_full_fbs))
]

qb_full_fbs <- qb_full_fbs %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(pct_cols),
      ~ {
        x <- as.character(.)
        x <- gsub("%", "", x)     # remove % if present
        x <- as.numeric(x)        # convert to numeric
        ifelse(x > 1, x / 100, x) # scale only if needed
      }
    )
  )

# --- 1. Prepare QB Data ---
qb_full_p4 <- qb_full_fbs %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4") %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number())

# --- 2. Save Identifiers ---
player_info <- qb_full_p4 %>% select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, All_Con)

# --- 3. Select Only Numeric Features ---
drop_cols <- c(
  "Player.Id", "Name", "Team", "Team.x", "Team.y", "Team.Name", "Team.Name.x", "Team.Name.y",
  "Conference", "Conference.x", "Conference.y", "Conference_Level",
  "Position", "Jersey.Number", "Jersey.Number.x", "Jersey.Number.y",
  "Player.College.GSIS", "Player.College.GSIS.x", "Player.College.GSIS.y",
  "Season", "Games.Won", "Explosive_Runs", "Player_Id"
)

df_clean <- qb_full_p4 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = qb_full_p4$Row_ID,
         All_Con = qb_full_p4$All_Con) %>%
  filter(rowSums(is.na(.)) == 0)

# --- 4. Remove Zero-Variance Columns ---
df_predictors <- df_clean %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)
zero_var_cols <- sapply(df_predictors, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
df_numeric <- df_predictors[, !zero_var_cols, drop = FALSE]

# --- 5. Drop Corrupted/Bad Correlation Columns ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
bad_cols <- colnames(cor_matrix)[apply(cor_matrix, 2, function(x) any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x)))]
df_numeric <- df_numeric %>% select(-any_of(bad_cols))

# --- 6. Reattach Labels ---
df_numeric$All_Con <- df_clean$All_Con[1:nrow(df_numeric)]
df_numeric$Row_ID  <- df_clean$Row_ID[1:nrow(df_numeric)]

# --- 7. Remove Highly Correlated Features ---
cor_matrix <- cor(df_numeric %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID))
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_matrix, cutoff = 0.7)
df_final <- df_numeric %>% select(-all_of(names(cor_matrix)[high_cor]), All_Con, Row_ID)

# --- 8. Remove Multicollinearity via VIF ---
reduce_vif <- function(df, threshold = 5) {
  y <- df$All_Con
  ids <- df$Row_ID
  X <- df %>% select(-All_Con, -Row_ID)

  qr_decomp <- qr(as.matrix(X))
  indep_cols <- qr_decomp$pivot[1:qr_decomp$rank]
  X_clean <- X[, indep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  df_clean <- cbind(X_clean, All_Con = y, Row_ID = ids)

  repeat {
    model <- glm(All_Con ~ ., data = df_clean %>% select(-Row_ID), family = binomial)
    vifs <- vif(model)
    if (max(vifs) < threshold) break
    worst <- names(which.max(vifs))
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-all_of(worst))
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

df_final_vif <- reduce_vif(df_final)
df_final_vif <- na.omit(df_final_vif)

# --- 9. Train/Test Split ---
set.seed(42)
train_index <- createDataPartition(df_final_vif$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df_final_vif[train_index, ]
test_data  <- df_final_vif[-train_index, ]

# --- 10. Train Random Forest Model ---
rf_model <- randomForest(as.factor(All_Con) ~ ., 
                         data = train_data %>% select(-Row_ID), 
                         ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# --- 11. Predict & Grade ---
pred_test_prob <- predict(rf_model, test_data, type = "prob")
test_data$Composite_Score <- pred_test_prob[, 2]

# Quantile-based grading
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 12. Merge Back with Names ---
test_data_named <- test_data %>% left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# --- 13. Output Top Players ---
player_grades <- test_data_named %>%
  select(Name, Team, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(head(player_grades, 20))

# --- 14. Visualizations ---
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of QB Player Grades", x = "Grade", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "QB Composite Score Distribution", x = "Score", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

#roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - QB All_Con")
#auc(roc_obj)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Feature Importance - P4 QB Model", x = "Feature", y = "MeanDecreaseGini") +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 15. Evaluation Metrics ---
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(predict(rf_model, test_data), as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity), na.rm = TRUE)
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0 || is.na(precision + recall)) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# --- 16. Predict on Full Dataset ---
full_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, df_final_vif %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con), type = "prob")
df_final_vif$Composite_Score <- full_pred_prob[, 2]

# --- 17. Attach Composite Score to Player Info ---
full_data_with_info <- df_final_vif %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- 18. Filter for 2025 Players Only ---
players_2025 <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_2025)
View(players_2025)

players_2025_stats <- full_data_with_info %>%
  filter(Season == 2025) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Player_Grade, Composite_Score, everything(), -Row_ID)

View(players_2025_stats)

rf_importance <- importance(rf_model)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(rf_importance),
  MeanDecreaseGini = rf_importance[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

print(head(importance_df, 20))
View(importance_df)
```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- Hybrid QB Grading Model ---
# Filter for P4 conferences only
qb_combined_week1_2024 <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Team != "ALABAMA", Attempts > 10)

colnames(qb_combined_week1_2024)

# --- 1. Define Feature Weights (Original Stats Only - NO FEATURE ENGINEERING) ---
feature_weights <- c(
  # --- HIGH IMPORTANCE (your RF output mapped correctly) ---
  "Pass.Grade" = 61.79376,
  "Passing.Touchdowns" = 39.506433,
  "Yards.per.Attempt.Pass" = 27.620529,
  "Uncatchable.Innacurage.Percentage" = -8.727091,
  "Dropped.Passes" = -6.362889,
  "Pass.Break.Up" = 5.471897,
  "Big.Time.Throw.Percentage" = 4.921824,
  "Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt" = 4.555593,
  "Accurate.Plus.Percentage" = 4.523584,
  "Turnover.Worthy.Plays.Percentage" = -4.457133,
  "Yards.After.Catch.per.Completion.Percentage" = 4.449415,
  "First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage" = 4.446795,
  "Rush.Grade" = 4.304240,
  "Play.Action.Percentage" = 4.290674,
  "Other.Percentage" = 4.195781,
  "Rush.Touchdowns" = 12.160278,
  "Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt" = 3.995910,
  "Average.Time.to.Throw" = 3.986278,
  "Sacks" = -3.893841,
  "Interceptions" = -3.820668,
  "Short.of.Sticks.Percentage" = -3.792841,
  "Catchable.Innacurate.Percentage" = -3.774847,
  "Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt" = 3.748329,
  "Turnover.Worthy.Plays" = -3.507209,
  "Change.of.direction.percentage" = 3.224754,
  "Batted.Passes" = -2.853414,
  "Fumbles" = -2.363499,
  "Fumbles.Lost" = -1.272567,

  # --- REMAINING COLUMNS (LOW WEIGHT BUT INCLUDED) ---
  "Completion.Percentage" = 3,
  "Adjusted.Completion.Percentage" = 3,
  "Passing.Yards" = 30,
  "NFL.Passer.Rating" = 4,
  "Average.Depth.of.Targets" = 2,
  "Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers" = 3,
  "Air.Yards.Percentage" = 2,
  "First.Downs" = 4,
  "Accuracy.Attempts" = 2,
  "Accurate.Throw.Percentage" = 3,
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,
  "Yards.per.Attempt.Rush" = 4,
  "First.Down.Runs" = 3,
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 2,
  "Scrambles" = 3,
  "Explosive.Runs" = 3
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final Summary ---
qb_eval_week1_summary <- qb_scored_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(qb_eval_week1_summary)
```

```{r}
    Yards_per_Dropback = Passing.Yards / pmax(Dropbacks, 1),
    Sack_Rate = Sacks / pmax(Dropbacks, 1),

                        (Passing.Touchdowns * 4) + (Rush.Touchdowns * 6),

    # Ball security (negative is good)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---

  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  ) %>%
  select(row_id, Name, Team, Conference, Conference_Level, Composite_Score)

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(Composite_Score = 0.05 + 0.95 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)))
} else {
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>% mutate(Composite_Score = 0.5)
}
# --- 6. Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final ---
qb_eval_week1_summary <- qb_scored_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))
```

```{r}
  "Big_Play_Rate" = 5,
  "Impact_Plays" = 5,
  "Rush_YPC" = 4,
  "First_Down_Rate" = 6,
  "Turnover_Rate" = -6,
  "Sack_Rate" = -4,
  "Dual_Threat_Score" = 8,
  "Completion_Premium" = 3
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    # Convert percentage columns to numeric
    Completion = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", Completion.Percentage)),
    Adjusted_Completion = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", Adjusted.Completion.Percentage)),
    
    # Advanced passing metrics
    TD_to_INT = (Passing.Touchdowns + 1) / pmax(Interceptions + 1, 1),  # Add 1 to avoid division issues
    Yards_per_Dropback = Passing.Yards / pmax(Dropbacks, 1),
    Sack_Rate = Sacks / pmax(Dropbacks, 1),
    Scramble_Rate = Scrambles / pmax(Dropbacks, 1),
    
    # Dual-threat composite score
    Dual_Threat_Score = (Passing.Yards / 100) + (Rush.Yards / 50) + 
                        (Passing.Touchdowns * 4) + (Rush.Touchdowns * 6),
    
    # Efficiency metrics
    Completion_Premium = Completion - 65,  # Bonus for high completion %
    Big_Play_Rate = (Big.Time.Throws + Explosive.Runs) / pmax(Dropbacks + Attempts, 1),
    
    # Impact plays
    Impact_Plays = coalesce(Pass.Break.Up, 0) + coalesce(Batted.Passes, 0) + 
                   coalesce(Big.Time.Throws, 0) + coalesce(Explosive.Runs, 0),
    
    # Rushing efficiency
    Rush_YPC = Rush.Yards / pmax(Attempts, 1),
    
    # Drive sustainability
    First_Down_Rate = (First.Downs + First.Down.Runs) / pmax(Dropbacks + Attempts, 1),
    
    # Ball security (negative is good)
    Turnover_Rate = (Interceptions + Fumbles) / pmax(Dropbacks + Attempts, 1)
  ) %>%
  # Handle any potential division issues
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.) | is.infinite(.), 0, .)))

model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
```
```{r}
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week4_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final Summary ---
qb_eval_week4_summary <- qb_scored_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

qb_full_view <- qb_combined_week4_2024 %>%

    Composite_Score = qb_scored_all$Composite_Score,

  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(qb_full_view)
```

```{r}
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
```
```{r}
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week5_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final Summary ---
qb_eval_week5_summary <- qb_scored_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(qb_eval_week5_summary)

# Create full view with ALL columns
qb_full_view <- qb_combined_week5_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Composite_Score = qb_scored_all$Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade = qb_scored_all$Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(qb_full_view)
```

```{r}
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week7_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final Summary ---

  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns

View(qb_full_view)
```

```{r}
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
```
```{r}
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week8_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

qb_full_view <- qb_combined_week8_2024 %>%

  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns

View(qb_full_view)
```

```{r}
  "Adjusted.Completion.Percentage" = 3,
```
```{r}
  "Passing.Yards" = 30,
  "NFL.Passer.Rating" = 4,
  "Average.Depth.of.Targets" = 2,
  "Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers" = 3,
  "Air.Yards.Percentage" = 2,
  "First.Downs" = 4,
  "Accuracy.Attempts" = 2,
  "Accurate.Throw.Percentage" = 3,
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,
  "Yards.per.Attempt.Rush" = 4,
  "First.Down.Runs" = 3,
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 2,
  "Scrambles" = 3,
  "Explosive.Runs" = 3
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week10_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week10_2024 %>%
  mutate(

    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
  "Adjusted.Completion.Percentage" = 3,
  "Passing.Yards" = 25,
  "Average.Depth.of.Targets" = 2,
  "First.Downs" = 4,
  "Accuracy.Attempts" = 2,
  "Accurate.Throw.Percentage" = 3,
  "Rush.Yards" = 5,
  "Yards.per.Attempt.Rush" = 4,
  "First.Down.Runs" = 3,
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Runs" = 2,
  "Scrambles" = 3,
  "Explosive.Runs" = 3
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week11_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week11_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
  "Scrambles" = 3,
  "Explosive.Runs" = 3
)

# --- 2. Prepare Features List ---
model_features <- names(feature_weights)

# --- 3. Data Processing ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%", "", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week13_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---

  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
```

```{r}
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out / 100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
```

```{r}
qb_input_all <- qb_combined_week14_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(model_features), ~ {
    v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
    v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

# --- 4. Imputation ---
impute_values <- vapply(
  model_features,
  function(f) suppressWarnings(stats::median(as.numeric(qb_input_all[[f]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
  numeric(1)
)

impute_values[is.na(impute_values)] <- 0

for (f in model_features) {
  fill_val <- ifelse(f %in% names(impute_values), impute_values[[f]], 0)
  qb_input_all[[f]][is.na(qb_input_all[[f]])] <- fill_val
}

# --- 5. Composite Score Calculation ---
calculate_weighted_score <- function(df, features, weights) {
  scores <- numeric(nrow(df))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(df)) {
      feature_values <- df[[feature]]
      
      if (weight < 0) {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- 1 - ((feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      } else {
        min_val <- min(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(feature_values, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        if (max_val > min_val) {
          normalized <- (feature_values - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)
        } else {
          normalized <- rep(0.5, length(feature_values))
        }
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  final_scores <- scores / total_weight
  return(final_scores)
}

qb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(qb_input_all, model_features, feature_weights)

# --- 6. Rescale Scores ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_combined_week14_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = qb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

if (length(unique(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(qb_scored_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  qb_scored_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# --- 7. Grade Assignment ---
qb_scored_all <- qb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Final Summary ---
qb_eval_week14_summary <- qb_scored_all %>%
  select(Name, Team, Offensive.Snaps, Composite_Score, Player_Grade) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

print(qb_eval_week14_summary)
View(qb_eval_week14_summary)

# --- SHOW FULL STATS + SCORES (ALL STATS) ---

# Get all column names from the original dataset (excluding the ones we'll add)
all_stats_cols <- setdiff(colnames(qb_combined_week14_2024), c("Composite_Score", "Player_Grade"))

# Create full view with ALL columns
qb_full_view <- qb_combined_week14_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Composite_Score = qb_scored_all$Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade = qb_scored_all$Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(all_stats_cols),  # All original columns
    Composite_Score,          # Add composite score
    Player_Grade              # Add player grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(qb_full_view)
print(qb_full_view)
```
